title: Otter

description.en: Keep your Mac development setup safe with snapshots, diffs, and cloud backups.
description.zh: 用快照、差异比较与云端备份，保存 Mac 开发环境的每一次变化。

subject.en: Brown otter in a relaxed curl holding one colorful river shell
subject.zh: 棕色水獭放松蜷起身体，捧着一枚多彩贝壳

description.en: The otter pauses in a relaxed curl and holds a shell beside its muzzle. Small ears, cream whisker pads, natural paws and a tapering tail make the species clear.
description.zh: 水獭放松地蜷起身体，将贝壳捧在嘴边。小耳朵、奶油色须垫、自然爪子与渐细长尾让物种特征更加清晰。

description.en: Chestnut, umber and cream replace the competing body colors. A single fan-shaped shell carries turquoise, coral, violet and gold beside the face.
description.zh: 栗棕、深棕与奶油色取代相互争抢的身体色块。一枚扇形贝壳在脸旁集中呈现松石、珊瑚、紫与金色。

description.en: Two broad offset eddies and a low bank sweep cross a blue-gray field. Open curves and fine grain give the warm animal a cooler, quiet setting.
description.zh: 两道宽阔错位的回旋和一条低岸曲线穿过蓝灰底色，开放曲线与细颗粒为暖色主体提供安静的冷色背景。

sizeNote.en: The complete animal and accessory have at least 224.5 px clearance from the actual rounded outline. Ten export sizes preserve one uniform placement. Small app/browser marks use the transparent foreground; fine facets and accessory details simplify at 16 px.
sizeNote.zh: 完整动物和兴趣点距离真实圆角轮廓至少 224.5 px。十种导出尺寸保持同一组等比位置，小型 UI 与浏览器使用透明主体；细小切面和装饰细节在 16 px 时会简化。

goal.en: Save macOS development settings and inventories as snapshots for inspection and migration.
goal.zh: 保存 macOS 开发环境配置与清单快照，方便查看变化和迁移电脑。

role.zh: CLI、采集器、API 与 Web 应用

role.zh: 单 Worker 提供 API 与静态资源
